summary: Adopt four-compartment silo pattern from blog-posts, adapted for an engineering project
Briefs are named YYYY-MM-DD-brief-slug.md — date-first so the record of intent sorts as a timeline
Machine configuration lives in pjsvis/machines (Omarchy as reference, Mac converging) — okuda hosts no machine configs; reverses docs/starship-mac.toml placement
Hard-wrap always — Okuda never delegates wrapping to the terminal
Render engine uses string protocols over Bun.markdown's string-in/string-out callbacks
Glow (glamour) dark palette as the default
Glow is the visual reference; diverge only for an okuda thing
Diagram borders are blueline, not recessive
Front matter elided, setext headings neutralised
Bounded anchor search + proportional fallback for resize scroll-preservation
The default palette is the okuda preset — identity over parity

Depth is top-down info in a post-order protocol — a PB-tag probe render maps containment to depth so renderList budgets the +4/level composition shift; counters can't work, re-wrapping doubles failure surface

meta.fixes: ADR-004 violation: nested list lines at term+2 (term+6 flattened)

summary: SSH serving shape — OpenSSH ForceCommand (Option 1)

An `alert` palette role for the fetch-state stamp's `failed` channel
argv[0] dispatch — `gloam` is the launcher entry point
Session handoffs are not briefs
Retire the "OKW" term
Adopt OKF v0.2 conformance for the document tree
Zero-notification stillness — identity lives on the status line
Jump tokens number from 11, not 01 — the ergonomic offset
Right-anchored role layout for patterned surfaces
